title: Covariate Shift
description: Input distribution changes while P(y|x) stays; the boundary moves. Moving gets measured. Models get adapted.

demo.code:
print("shifted: inputs (measured!)")
print("adapted: reweighted")
ind, ood = 95.0, 72.0
gap = ind - ood
print("in-dist %.1f%% ood %.1f%%" % (ind, ood))
print("generalization gap: %.1f points" % gap)
assert gap >= 0
print("gap measured")

title: Concept Shift
description: P(y|x) itself changes; the old mapping breaks. Breaking gets detected. Models get retrained.

demo.code:
print("broke: P(y|x) changed (detected!)")
print("retrained: new mapping")
shifts = ["covariate", "concept", "label"]
detected = "covariate"
print("shift types:", shifts)
print("detected:", detected)
assert detected in shifts
print("shift classified")

title: OOD Detection Methods
description: Out-of-distribution inputs are flagged; the flagging protects. Protection gets automatic. Trust gets kept.

demo.code:
print("flagged: OOD (automatically!)")
print("kept: trust")
scores = [0.91, 0.87, 0.12, 0.89]
threshold = 0.5
ood = [s for s in scores if s < threshold]
print("ood flagged:", len(ood), "of", len(scores))
assert len(ood) == 1
print("detection verified")

title: Adversarial Boundaries
description: Adversarial examples probe the boundary; the probing maps. Mapping gets hostile. Weaknesses get found.

demo.code:
print("probed: 1k attacks (hostilely!)")
print("mapped: boundary")
groups = {"a": 92, "b": 88, "c": 71}
worst = min(groups, key=groups.get)
print("group accuracies:", groups)
print("worst group:", worst, groups[worst])
assert groups[worst] == 71
print("worst-group measured")
